extracted.intended_audience: Researchers applying for or managing Wellcome grants; research managers
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for prospective and current Wellcome grant holders on eligibility, preparing applications, the decision-making process, grant management, claiming funds, and closing projects. Includes policies, committee processes, and practical steps for receiving and reporting funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare to apply
rubrics_metrics.description: Everything you need to know to understand if you can apply, check if your research is right for Wellcome, write your application and prepare for interview.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers eligibility checking, assessing fit with Wellcome's remit, practical advice for writing the application, and preparing for interviews. (Implied: follow eligibility rules, demonstrate fit, craft a clear application, and rehearse interview answers.)

rubrics_metrics.name: How Wellcome makes funding decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Read about Wellcome's policies and process for making funding decisions and explore our funding advisory committees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Wellcome's decision-making policies, description of the review and assessment process, and roles/functions of advisory committees (implied criteria used in selection and assessment).

rubrics_metrics.name: Managing your grant
rubrics_metrics.description: Everything you need to manage your research project and support the people working on it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on project management, governance, personnel/support responsibilities, and compliance with funder expectations during the grant period.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to claim grant funds
rubrics_metrics.description: Everything you need to know to claim your research costs, get set up to receive funding if this is your first award, and contacts to help you along the way.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical instructions on eligible costs, financial administration, onboarding procedures for first-time awardees, invoicing/claims process, and support contacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ending a grant
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn how to report the outcomes of your project, publish your findings, and claim your final grant payment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements and steps for final reporting, publication expectations, dissemination of results, and claiming the final payment at grant close-out.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding policies and grant conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: How we expect you to manage and conduct your research projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets out funder expectations, policies, terms and conditions governing conduct, research integrity, use of funds, and compliance obligations.
